title: vicia cracca subsp. stenophylla
intro: Vicia cracca subsp. stenophylla, commonly known as Narrow-leaved vetch, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Narrow-leaved vetch include wound healing, anti-ulcerative activity, and the ability to inhibit the growth of certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents of Narrow-leaved vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
